title: Worked Computation of the Dining Allowance Carry-over Amount (Guest Folios, Ashbury Rewards)
content:
The amount of an Ashbury Rewards dining allowance carry-over on Guest Folios, and the line it lands on, are fixed by the following computation.

## Day and line

The carry-over is made for the most recent business date of the stay on which a food and beverage line was charged, and it is applied to the largest food and beverage line of that business date.

## Amount

The carry-over is the day's dining allowance less the elite credits already standing for that business date, that is the elite breakfast credits of that morning whoever posted them and any carry-over already applied that day, never below zero and never more than the food and beverage line it is applied to, rounded half up to the cent at the end. The day's dining allowance is the brand's elite breakfast credit per person times the brand's persons covered.

In other words, three amounts meet on one business date: the day's dining allowance, the elite credits already standing on the folio for that date (every elite breakfast credit line dated to it, whether posted by the outlet or by guest services, and any carry-over already applied that day), and the food and beverage line chosen. The carry-over is what is left of the allowance after the standing credits, floored at zero, and then held to the amount of that food and beverage line. Rounding is applied once, to the final carry-over.

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| The business date | The most recent business date of the stay carrying a food and beverage line |
| The food and beverage line | The largest food and beverage line of that business date |
| Elite credits standing for that date | Every elite credit line on the folio dated to that business date |
| The brand's elite breakfast credit per person and persons covered | The brand's figures in the breakfast entitlement grid |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Inputs: brand credit per person $30.00, persons covered 2; the most recent business date with a food and beverage charge is 22 September, whose food and beverage lines are $64.20 and $18.00; the folio carries elite breakfast credits dated 22 September of $38.00 in total.

1. The day's dining allowance is $30.00 times 2: $60.00.
2. Less the standing credits of $38.00: $22.00, which is not below zero.
3. Held to the largest food and beverage line of $64.20: $22.00 stands.
4. Carry-over: **$22.00**, applied to the $64.20 line of 22 September.

## Boundary cases (same hypothetical allowance of $60.00)

| Standing credits for the date | Largest food and beverage line | Carry-over |
|---|---|---|
| $60.00 | $64.20 | $0.00 (nothing remains) |
| $71.00 | $64.20 | $0.00 (never below zero) |
| $20.00 | $15.40 | $15.40 (never more than the line) |
| $0.00 | $90.00 | $60.00 |
